QuestInfo.name: Burying Fossils 2
QuestInfo.0: Sean has another favor to ask of you. Ask him what's up.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the new and improved Skeleton Soldiers and Skeleton Officers.\r\n They're raising a ruckus in the #b#m102040400# and #m102040500##k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Skeleton Soldiers and Skeleton Officers for the excavators.

0.0: The #m102040400# and #m102040500# are a total shambles! The only way we can get things back in order is if we put those skeletons back to sleep. You up for the job?

yes.0: Smash the Skeleton Soldiers and Skeleton Officers in the #m102040400# and #m102040500#.

no.0: Take a moment to catch your breath, then talk to me when you're ready.

1.0: You get rid of those skeletons? Good. Great! Now I got just one more job for you!

mob.0: Beat 100 Skeleton Soldiers and Skeleton Officers. Do that, and we can get back to work!
